events.verdict: Schroder (SAC) cleanly blocks Kuminga's (GSW) shot attempt at the rim.
Schroder (SAC) contests Podziemski's (GSW) jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with their arm does not prevent them from following through.
DeRozan (SAC) and Podziemski (GSW) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Podziemski (GSW) grazes DeRozan's (SAC) left arm at the end of his drive, and the contact that occurs prior to DeRozan's gather is marginal.
Horford (GSW) contests DeRozan's (SAC) shot attempt and the contact that occurs after he has released his shot attempt is marginal.
Richard (GSW) and Eubanks (SAC) come together at the same spot as they pursue the loose ball, and the contact that occurs as the long rebound sails overhead is marginal.
Kuminga (GSW) goes to, not through, DeRozan's (SAC) space as they come together at the end of the drive.  DeRozan steps on Kuminga's right foot, which is what causes DeRozan to fall to the floor.
Schroder (SAC) does not move into Kuminga's (GSW) lower body as Kuminga jumps forward to pursue the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
Moody (GSW) initiates foot to foot contact with Schroder (SAC) that affects his SQBR.  This contact occurs prior to any potential traveling violation by Schroder.
Richard (GSW) commits a take foul on Schroder (SAC).
Ellis (SAC) commits a take foul on Horford (GSW).
Westbrook (SAC) cleanly dislodges the ball from Podziemski (GSW).  Any ensuing arm contact that occurs after the ball is dislodged is considered incidental.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Podziemski (GSW) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Podziemski is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to the Kings.
Moody (GSW) commits a take foul on DeRozan (SAC).
Ellis (SAC) legally contests Kuminga's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
